privacy.text: Privacy policy

Updated 22 October 2026. This policy covers the KiwiKind Broadband Android app and customer portal. KiwiKind Broadband Limited (NZBN 9429054036550), incorporated on 19 October 2026, operates KiwiKind Broadband. Free accounts, support conversations and broadband order requests are available. We confirm address availability and connection details before payment. Automatic supplier ordering is disabled. The Google Play developer display name is FryMasterCheese Studios.
Contact
For support, privacy, access, correction or account deletion, email kiwikindbroadband@gmail.com. You do not need to sign in to contact us.
Information we collect

Signing in sends your email and account identifiers to our backend. Google sign-in supplies a verified email and Google account identifier; we do not receive your Google password. Email/password sign-in sends your password over HTTPS; the backend stores a one-way password hash, not a readable password. Essential cookies maintain sessions and protect forms. Android stores its session encrypted with a key held by Android Keystore; a session is still checked by the server.

If you choose to send support or privacy messages, we collect their subject, category, contents and timestamps. Do not include payment-card details, identity documents or health information. Security and service logs can contain request paths, timestamps, network addresses, browser/device information and authentication/audit events.

Broadband plan requests are open for manual address and connection confirmation. Supplier provisioning is never triggered automatically by submitting a request. Confirmed, individually approved payment offers are described below. Network availability and installation dates are not guaranteed. Address, contact name, postcode and optional phone fields exist in the software for future requests, but customer intake is closed. We will update relevant notices before enabling collection for live services.
How information is used

We use account data to authenticate you, maintain your account, show your own records across the website and Android app, respond to your messages, provide privacy controls and prevent abuse. A website session and Android session are separate; they access the same server-side account. Account and support records are not passed to advertising placements. Android advertising behavior by version is described below; V6 and V7 are ad-free.
Hosting and service providers

The secure account API is hosted on Render, with PostgreSQL data hosted by Neon. Current service regions are Singapore for the application and Sydney, Australia for the database. GitHub Pages hosts the public website and account/owner interfaces. Private records come from the secure API after server-side authentication. Essential cross-site session and security cookies keep you signed in; browser cookie blocking may prevent sign-in. No session credentials or private records are saved in browser local storage. Google processes Google sign-in. When configured, Brevo processes transactional verification/reset email, including recipient address and the message needed for account recovery. Email delivery can be unavailable during prelaunch. These providers process information to deliver the specified functions; we do not sell personal information or provide account/support records for targeted advertising. Google advertising SDK processing is described below. Provider operational processing may occur overseas.
Referral preview and account preferences

If you choose to create a referral code, we store the code against your account. When referral registration is enabled, we record who referred a new account and whether its email is verified. Referral history shows status and date, not invited people’s email addresses. Codes are shareable; share them only where appropriate. Rewards, discounts, financial credits and referral registration are disabled during prelaunch. Notification preferences are stored with your account, but notification delivery and marketing remain disabled.
Android advertising

The public information website does not load advertising code. Android V6 and V7 are ad-free; V8 through V11 restrict requests to SDK-recognised test devices. Version 0.2.10 (V12) permits live banner requests in the signed release, using KiwiKind’s own AdMob App ID and banner unit with Google Mobile Ads SDK 25.5.0 and User Messaging Platform 4.0.0. Google controls ad availability and may limit serving before app review is complete. SDK-recognised test devices and emulators continue to receive test ads; development builds remain test-only. A banner is shown only on public Home after Google’s consent checks permit a request. Sign-in, account, support, billing, privacy and deletion screens have no advertising placements. Advertising is separate from payments. Billing screens have no advertising. Public retail plans and supplier orders remain disabled.
Advertising data and choices

The Google SDKs may process IP address and general location, app interactions, diagnostic information and device or installation identifiers for ad delivery, measurement and fraud prevention. Data may be transmitted to Google and its advertising technology providers, including processing overseas. Removing the Android Advertising ID permission does not eliminate all SDK data processing; current builds omit that permission and does not request precise device location. No KiwiKind email address, password, support message, billing record or referral record is included in an ad request.

Google’s applicable consent message explains purposes and providers and offers Consent, Do not consent and Manage options. Refusing personalisation is distinct from preventing every permitted limited-ad request. Requests are made only when Google’s consent system permits them; applicable privacy choices remain available. Use Advertising privacy choices on public Home or the native Privacy policy screen to revisit choices where Google requires an options form. Opening privacy choices removes the banner, and no automatic ad reload follows. If choices cannot load, ads remain off and essential account functions remain available.

Google controls retention of its SDK data under Google’s Privacy Policy and advertising technology information. Consent preferences may be stored on the device. KiwiKind has no advertising-cookie script on the website; existing essential account cookies remain separate. Website advertising cookies or additional providers require reviewed disclosures, applicable consent and explicit owner authorisation before activation. Google’s app review and serving limits are separate from your privacy choices.
Security

The connected app uses HTTPS and disallows cleartext HTTP. Access to account records is restricted by server authentication. Android app backups are disabled. No system is risk-free; protect your device and credentials, and keep account exports private. Support requests must not contain secrets.
Retention and deletion

We keep account and support records while needed for the account, support, security and any applicable legal duties. There is currently no automatic account-expiry or data-purge schedule; deletion requests are reviewed and processed manually. A request acknowledgement does not mean records have already been deleted.

On a verified deletion request, we review the account and associated support/request records for deletion. If any information must be retained for a legal or security reason, we explain the categories, reason and applicable retention period. Existing recovery snapshots may contain older copies until the snapshot is retired; they are used for recovery rather than ordinary account access. A restore must preserve verified deletion instructions.

You can request account deletion from the app or this public deletion page. Google-only users do not need a KiwiKind password to use the email pathway. We may verify control of the account email before acting, without asking for your password.
Your choices

You can sign out, request an account export in the portal/app, or contact us for access, correction and deletion. Sending support messages is optional. The app is intended for adults managing their own accounts, not children. Policy changes will be published here with a revised date.
Private payment offers and Stripe

Customers receive a private payment offer after KiwiKind confirms their address and connection details. An approved offer shows the full monthly amount, one-time setup amount, GST and written service terms. The totals include exactly $3 extra monthly and $10 extra setup once, both including GST. A payment requires your explicit agreement and is available only when live checkout is enabled. After consent, KiwiKind sends your account email, internal agreement reference and agreed amounts to Stripe. Stripe hosts the payment form and processes card details; KiwiKind does not receive full card numbers. KiwiKind stores the agreed terms, consent audit, subscription, invoice, payment, refund and dispute references so you can see your records across the website and app. Status comes from verified Stripe notifications, not a browser return page. Payment does not automatically activate broadband or place a supplier order. You can request cancellation of future subscription billing at the current period end; service cancellation and contractual obligations are handled separately with KiwiKind. Refunds are reviewed by KiwiKind. Exports include your payment records; deletion requests require review for lawful financial record retention and related Stripe records. Stripe may process information overseas under its privacy policy. Sandbox billing remains separate and accepts test details only.
Stripe privacy policy
Broadband order details

When you submit a broadband order, we store your selected plan and options, quoted totals, service address, postcode, contact name and optional phone number in your KiwiKind account. We use them to check availability, prepare your confirmed offer and manage your connection. You can view your order on the website and app. Payment is requested only after confirmation. Automatic supplier ordering remains disabled.

deletion.text: This page covers the KiwiKind Broadband Android app (package nz.kiwikind.broadband) and shared website account.

Email kiwikindbroadband@gmail.com with the subject KiwiKind account deletion request. Send from the email used for your KiwiKind account if possible, and say that you want the account and its associated data deleted. You can use this page without signing in or reinstalling the app.

Google-only account? You do not need a KiwiKind password. Do not send your Google password, KiwiKind password, login code, reset link, identity document or payment information. If you cannot access the account email, explain that in your message so we can discuss proportionate verification.

We verify account ownership, review the account and associated support/request records, and process the request manually. No account or data is deleted merely by opening this page. If information must be retained for a legal or security reason, we explain what is retained, why and for how long. Recovery snapshots can contain earlier copies until retired; verified deletion instructions must be respected after recovery.

You can also request deletion from the signed-in app or portal. Google-only users can explicitly confirm a manual deletion review using their authenticated account, without setting a password. The password-protected request remains available for email/password accounts; the public email pathway is available to all users, including Google sign-in users.

Broadband plan requests may be submitted for address review; supplier provisioning remains manual and subject to confirmation. This deletion request does not require buying a service or paying a fee. Read our privacy policy or contact the same email for access/correction requests.

terms.text: Broadband orders and account terms

Updated 22 October 2026. These terms explain the KiwiKind website, free account and order review process. They are not your final broadband service contract. The service-specific consumer agreement, approved prices, installation conditions and retail terms must be separately reviewed and accepted before payment or service activation.
Who operates the site?

KiwiKind Broadband Limited, NZBN 9429054036550, New Zealand company number 9466791. Contact kiwikindbroadband@gmail.com for support, privacy questions or corrections. The public website is hosted on GitHub Pages. The account portal uses a separate secure backend shared by the Android app.
Choose a plan and request a connection

Browse the broadband catalogue, select your speed, data and installation or router options, and submit your service address and contact details. All displayed prices are NZD including GST. The totals include exactly $3 extra monthly and $10 extra setup once; GST is not added again to these additions.

Submitting an order requests an address and connection check. No payment is taken and no service is activated at that stage. Prices labelled “to confirm”, usage charges and eligibility restrictions must be resolved in your final offer. Secondary fibre options require an eligible existing connection. Speeds and availability depend on your address and network.
Confirmation before payment

KiwiKind reviews the service address and connection details manually. Once confirmed, your final offer appears under Billing in My KiwiKind on the website and app. It must state the selected service, full monthly and setup amounts, payment start, installation, equipment, contract, cancellation and refund terms. You can then accept that offer and continue to Stripe.

Creating an account or submitting an order does not accept a minimum term or authorise cancellation of your existing connection. Do not cancel your current broadband until switching and installation arrangements are confirmed.
Website accounts and security

Use accurate account contact information and keep credentials secure. Google sign-in and email/password sign-in use the separate shared backend. Do not send passwords, reset links, card details or identity documents in support messages. Data and deletion choices are covered by our privacy policy.
Final offers and consumer rights

Every final offer needs separate confirmation of service address, supplier availability, approved GST-inclusive monthly and one-off prices, speed limitations, equipment, minimum term, cancellation, switching authority, installation and support arrangements. Nothing here excludes rights that cannot lawfully be excluded under New Zealand law, including applicable rights under the Consumer Guarantees Act 1993 and Fair Trading Act 1986.
Support, complaints and account deletion

Contact kiwikindbroadband@gmail.com for account support or complaints. No live service-support SLA or membership in a telecommunications dispute scheme is promised unless stated in your confirmed service terms. Account deletion instructions are available without signing in.
Changes

We may update these order and account terms. Changes do not alter an offer you have already accepted. This page alone does not authorise charges or supplier provisioning; payment requires your separate acceptance of the final offer.
← Back to KiwiKind Broadband
Approved payment offers

Creating an account does not authorise charges. Every payment offer must identify the specific service, full GST-inclusive monthly and one-time setup amounts, payment start, installation, equipment, contract, cancellation and refund terms before acceptance. A customer must separately accept that offer before Stripe checkout. Payment does not automatically activate broadband or place a supplier order. The $3 monthly and $10 one-time setup additions are already included in the displayed totals, including GST. Contact KiwiKind about refunds and broadband cancellation; stopping subscription payments alone does not cancel contractual service obligations.
